rules.content: This is a Bun monorepo with 11 workspace packages. Use `bun test` not `npm test`.
Never use non-null assertions (!) without validation. Always validate env vars and optional values.
Use lucide-react for icons. Never create custom SVGs unless absolutely necessary.
Flag surprises — if something in the codebase is unexpected, mention it in the review.
Check for circular dependency patterns between packages. Use init() functions for lazy loading.
RTL awareness: Hebrew text should be text-right, items-end. Flex order is reversed in RTL.
